# GET /api/v1/user/followers

List the authenticated user's followers

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-139`

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | user.ListMyFollowers | controller | call listUserFollowers with current user |
| 2 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | user.listUserFollowers | controller | get list options; call user_model.GetUserFollowers; set pagination headers; convert to API users |
| 3 | [models](../modules/models.md) | user_model.GetUserFollowers | repository | JOIN follow ON user.id=follow.user_id WHERE follow.follow_id=u.ID; filter by user type=individual; apply visibility condition based on viewer |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Follower visibility is filtered based on viewer permissions - admin sees all, anonymous sees only public, signed-in sees non-private | authorization | viewer is nil/restricted/admin/normal |
| GetUserFollowers only returns users of type Individual (not orgs) | business_logic | always |
